text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ardan, you might want to get ready for
bed
earlier today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Otherwise, an ordinary cold
could
become the least of my
worries—achooey!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A-are you okay?! Oh no! Um, um!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Is there something I can do for you?
We're
roommates, so no request will
ever be too much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm perfectly all right... Although I
appreciate
the sentiment.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, i-if you're sure...

Excuse me for intruding during your
moment of
respite.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is your condition improving, Ardan? I
come
bearing many gifts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, are these all for me? Thank you
very much.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I brought you some cold medicine, a
cooling
patch for your fever, face masks,
and canned
peaches... It's nothing
extravagant, but I hope it
aids in your
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Should you require anything else, just
say the
word!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well... If I might make use of your
goodwill, I do
have a request.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Oh, I see it now. She'd rather ask Yaeno

instead...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Could you let Chiyono O stay in your
room until I
make a complete recovery?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's quite easy to pass on a summer cold.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That is no bother for me in the slightest!
I'll go
talk it over with my roommate.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Yaeno, you're so capable. And then
there's me,
unable to do a single thing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Whatever do you mean? I'm sure your
presence
brings her more than enough
comfort.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why Ardan is concerned
over
your safety.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-you really think so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... This room is awfully quiet when no one's around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I should get a little outside air...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... My throat feels so much better
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh my, I'm getting a call.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ardan, can you hear me? There's
something I
forgot to tell you earlier.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, feel free to call whenever you like!
We could
always just talk even if there's
nothing bothering
you! I know you get
lonely by yourself at night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you very much. I hope you'll
be my
conversation partner in my
moments of ennui.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... so, so much. I'll do my best
to get
well for you too.
